banh-trang-nuong.author: Light Write
banh-trang-nuong.description:
A food stall selling bánh tráng nướng - a popular street food in Vietnam.
Ingredients for bánh tráng nướng including rice paper base, margarine, and (from rear), minced pork, green onions, tiny shrimp, and quail eggs. There are other toppings not visible (sauces and such). The result is a sort of mini street pizza
